name: PolyWerk
author: Devko
summary: Eight-voice wavetable synth: two wavetable oscillators with 8x unison and subs, 30 built-in tables plus your own Serum-format WAVs, two filters with comb and vowel, two LFOs, a 12-slot mod matrix, arpeggiator and sequencers, 205 presets and a seven-tab touchscreen skin with Q-Links.
